description: Angular component for a key filter dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing form controls, entity key fetching, and user interactions.

classes.name: KeyFilterDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring key filters with form validation, entity key fetching, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and resources when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state for UI validation feedback.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the key input field and resets focus.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on the input, updating validation state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and submits the form data, closing the dialog with the filter info.

methods.name: isConstantKeyType
methods.description: Checks if the selected key type is 'CONSTANT'.

methods.name: fetchEntityName
methods.description: Fetches entity key names matching the search text.

methods.name: getEntityKeys
methods.description: Retrieves entity keys based on the selected key type, with caching.
